items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey evaluated for head injury then ruled out with concussion mid-game.
items.why: In-game head injury evaluation leading to concussion ruling; Rapoport confirms.
items.implication: LAC WR corps depleted further; remaining WRs (Johnston etc.) elevated rest-of-game and potential multi-week if protocol.
items.opportunity: Immediate target/route share to Quentin Johnston and other Chargers pass-catchers; monitor protocol for ROS.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore inactive; Josh Palmer active.
items.implication: BUF WR targets redistribute; Palmer elevated opportunity.
items.opportunity: Snap/route/target share increase for Josh Palmer and remaining BUF pass-catchers.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive after GTD/questionable ankle tag; Browns RB depth limited to Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime (PS elevate).
items.why: Pregame workout/status determination after limited practice week; Schefter/Rapoport confirm out.
items.implication: Zero Judkins production; thin CLE backfield forces committee or limited upside backups.
items.opportunity: Backup carries/snaps to McLaughlin/Estime in potential larger roles vs BAL.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive (groin/questionable to GTD); Colts TE out.
items.why: Late-week groin issue; official inactive confirmed by Schefter/Colts/Rapoport.
items.implication: Lose TE volume; IND pass-catchers (Downs etc.) see target bump.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Josh Downs and other IND WRs/TEs in red zone/third down.

items.text: Eagles place Jalen Hurts on IR (blood clot) after doctor consults; out indefinitely/foreseeable future. Jaydon Blue signed/activated.
items.why: Official IR placement confirmed jointly with Schefter; multi-doctor process.
items.implication: PHI QB change for multiple weeks minimum; backup starts, Blue RB depth add.
items.opportunity: Increased rushing/ dual usage potential shift or pass volume to WRs/TEs (Smith/Goedert/Wicks); Blue handcuff stash.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Davante Adams (leg) among others (McConkey concussion already out, Kincaid ribs returned, Doubs/Bateman shoulder, Mooney neck).
items.why: In-game or post leg issue flagged in ETR late summary.
items.implication: Monitor for next-week status; LAR WR depth if limited/out.
items.opportunity: Potential snap increase for Nacua/other LAR WRs if Adams limited ROS.

items.text: Still starting Cam Skattebo if forced to play NYG RB for explosiveness/TD upside vs NO, but now riskier flex (updated RB28) rather than RB2 amid rotation/Najee increase; prefers Najee over DK Metcalf in some spots for TD chance.
items.why: Explosiveness edge in favorable matchup despite fumbles/role risk; preseason hate list caution realized.
items.implication: Flex-only with volatility; Happy Hour covered Cam/Najee/Judkins/Warren.
items.conflict: Conflicts with pure efficiency/YOE data favoring volume shift to Najee.

items.text: Cam Skattebo 37th/43 RBs in rush YOE with 4 fumbles (1 lost); Giants expected to expand Najee Harris role while keeping Skattebo in mix (all 4 RBs active). Zero carries in game per reports.
items.why: Fumble issues + poor efficiency data; beat sources on rotation change. Coach later said zero carries not by design/bench.
items.implication: Skattebo riskier flex/RB2; explosiveness still gives TD chance vs NO but volume cut.
items.opportunity: Larger snap/carry share for Najee Harris; monitor Tracy/Singletary too.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers starting Skattebo over pure volume alternatives for upside but ranks RB28 riskier flex.

items.text: Caleb Williams expected to play and confirmed active/returning from hamstring.
items.why: Full participant practices; ETR expected + Schefter/Rapoport/inactives confirm return. Victory speeches noted.
items.implication: CHI offense stabilizes; full QB1 projection restored.
items.opportunity: Normal dropback/ dual-threat usage for Williams and CHI pass-catchers (Odunze/Burden/Loveland).

items.text: AJ Brown and TreVeyon Henderson expected and officially active (Brown activated to 53, Henderson ankle cleared).
items.why: ETR expected; Rapoport likely then active; Schefter on Brown roster move.
items.implication: NE near full health; Brown WR2+ usage, Henderson RB involvement.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Brown; carries/snaps for Henderson in NE backfield.

items.text: Deebo Samuel not expected to play.
items.implication: WAS WR depth thins; other Commanders pass-catchers elevated.
items.opportunity: Target share to McLaurin/Diggs/etc. in WAS.

items.text: Chris Olave and Alvin Kamara expected to play and active.
items.why: ETR summary expected; inactives/beat confirm no issues.
items.implication: NO offense at full strength for skill players.
items.opportunity: Standard target/carry shares restored for both.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams (RB5) vs ARI for elite recent usage and soft run D; also Javonte Williams goal-line role @GB and Rhamondre vs NYJ.
items.why: Volume + leaking run defenses; Kyren usage elite, Javonte GL work.
items.implication: Strong start candidates in favorable scripts.
items.opportunity: High carry/red-zone shares in positive matchups.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans (WR4) and Drake London (WR6) vs soft defenses (WSH/CHI); also Kittle. Hates Waddle vs SEA and Egbuka vs PIT on matchup/QB issues.
items.why: WSH buffet for pass-catchers; London bankable usage. Hates ugly matchups/shaky QB.
items.opportunity: High target shares expected in positive game scripts for loves.
